questions.stem: According to the passage, what are the two most common prefixes in English?
questions.evidence: U-n and r-e ( or re - ) are the two most common prefixes in the English language.
questions.explanation_ko: 영어에서 가장 흔한 두 접두사는 un-과 re-라고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT listed as a common suffix?
questions.evidence: Some common suffixes are -er, -s, -es, - ed, -ing and - ly.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that "loveful" is not a real word, even though -ful means "full of"?
options: Prefixes and suffixes can be added to any word without restriction.
Prefixes and suffixes follow patterns, but those patterns don't apply to every possible word.
The suffix -ful can never be added to a noun.
English learners should avoid using suffixes altogether.
questions.evidence: we cannot add -ful to just any noun. You could not, for example, say "loveful" to mean full of love.
questions.explanation_ko: -ful을 아무 명사에나 붙일 수 없다는 예시에서, 접두사·접미사 규칙에는 예외가 있어 모든 단어에 적용되지는 않음을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author suggest taking a news story and looking for words with the prefixes and suffixes learned?
options: To give learners a way to practice applying what they learned in real texts
To criticize news articles for using difficult words
To recommend a specific news website
To explain how journalists write headlines
questions.evidence: take a news story or page in a book and look for words that have the prefixes and suffixes you learned
questions.explanation_ko: 이 제안은 학습자가 배운 내용을 실제 글에 적용해 연습할 방법을 제시하기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "frightening" mean in "a lot less frightening"?
questions.evidence: can make unfamiliar English words a lot less frightening

blanks.sentence_ko: 기억을 되살리기 위해 말하자면, 어근은 단어의 가장 단순한 형태이다.
흔한 접두사와 접미사의 뜻을 아는 것은 우연히 마주치는 낯선 영어 단어를 이해하는 데 도움이 될 수 있다.
접두사와 접미사 모두에 대해 명심할 점은, 일부는 특정 단어에만 쓰인다는 것이다.
접두사와 접미사를 배우는 것은 어휘를 늘려 줄 뿐 아니라 낯선 영어 단어를 훨씬 덜 두렵게 만들어 줄 수 있다.

key_points: Prefixes are added to the beginning of words and suffixes to the end, and learning them helps with both understanding new words and spelling.
The prefixes un- and re- are the two most common in English, while common suffixes include -er, -s, -es, -ed, -ing, and -ly.
Prefix and suffix rules have exceptions; some, like -ful, cannot be added to every noun.
Ways to practice include using online flashcard tools like Quizlet or making your own, and then looking for these patterns in real texts like news stories.
main_idea: Learning common English prefixes and suffixes, along with practicing them, can help learners understand and spell unfamiliar words more easily.
restate_sentence: Learning the meanings of common prefixes and suffixes can help you understand unknown English words you come across.
